summary: The agent provides a robust, high-quality solution utilizing a tuned ensemble of gradient boosting trees and a well-regularized PyTorch Tabular ResNet. The cross-validation pipeline is generally very sound, properly scoping scaling and imputation. The only minor issues observed are the calculation of aggregate grouping statistics on the full training set prior to CV splitting (causing a slight distribution leak) and a reliance on a single evaluation metric.
